# Version 4.147.0
> **Skia m147 preview** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.147.0-preview)

> **Superseded by [4.148.0](4.148.0.md)** · Never released as stable — these changes rolled up into 4.148.0.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.147.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/8.3.1.6/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.147.0 previews Skia m147 with variable fonts and the new SKPathBuilder API. It also adds animated WebP encoding, color font palettes, surface sampling controls, and new Linux and Tizen assets. This preview raises the WebAssembly floor to .NET 8 and removes 32-bit Tizen assets, so review the migration notes before upgrading.

## Breaking Changes

- **SKPath mutation moves to SKPathBuilder** — SKPath mutation methods and SKPath destinations for fill-path and segment operations are now obsolete. Move path construction to SKPathBuilder and use its Detach or Snapshot methods; use the new SKPathBuilder overloads for SKPaint.GetFillPath and SKPathMeasure.GetSegment. ([#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702))
- **GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo renamed to GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo** — GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo now uses GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo. Update references to the correctly cased type; the obsolete GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo compatibility type no longer supplies its former IEquatable implementation or equality operators. ([#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001))
- **WebAssembly native assets now require .NET 8** — Native assets for Emscripten versions associated with .NET 6 and .NET 7 are removed, and those targets now produce a build error. Upgrade Blazor WebAssembly or Uno Platform WebAssembly projects to .NET 8 or later. ([#4022](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4022))
- **32-bit Tizen native assets removed** — Tizen arm and x86 native builds no longer ship. Move supported Tizen deployments to the tizen-arm64 or tizen-x64 runtime identifiers. ([#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702))
- **SKStream.Move validates its 32-bit native range** — SKStream.Move(long) is obsolete and now throws OverflowException when the offset cannot fit the native 32-bit operation instead of silently truncating it. Use offsets within the Int32 range and migrate away from the long overload. ([#3714](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3714))
- **Assembly version moves to 4.x** — SkiaSharp.dll now reports assembly version 4.147.0.0 instead of 3.119.0.0. Update strong-name binding redirects and any hard-coded assembly-version checks.

## Engine

- **Skia advances from m119 through m147** — The bundled engine incorporates improved EXIF orientation, HDR and wide-gamut processing, color-aware filters, CICP color spaces, R16Unorm and additional HDR color types, and the upstream immutable-path model. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3560](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3560), [#3660](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3660), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702))
- **Bundled image and font dependencies refreshed** — Updates libpng to 1.6.58, libexpat to 2.7.5, zlib to 1.3.2.1-motley, FreeType to 2.14.3, and libjpeg-turbo to 3.1.4.1. ([#3718](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3718), [#3717](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3717), [#3720](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3720), [#3726](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3726), [#4012](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4012))

## API Surface

- **Variable fonts and color font palettes** — SKTypeface, SKFontArguments and HarfBuzzSharp expose variation axes, design coordinates, named instances, palette selection and palette overrides; HBColor preserves HarfBuzz's BGRA representation and converts to SkiaSharp colors. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3703](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3703), [#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742), [#4000](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4000))
- **SKPathBuilder becomes the path construction API** — The new builder wraps path mutation and adds builder destinations for fill paths and measured segments, while the engine update also exposes codec memory limits and XPS options. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702))
- **Surface draws gain sampling controls** — New SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas.DrawSurface overloads accept SKSamplingOptions so callers can select filtering when compositing surfaces. ([#3491](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3491))
- **Animated WebP and direct stream data access** — SKWebpEncoder encodes frame sequences, while SKStream.GetData returns ref-counted SKData when a stream can expose its backing data directly. ([#3771](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3771), [#3772](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3772))
- **Previously unwrapped engine operations exposed** — Adds SKDocument.CreateXps options overloads, per-resource GRContext.Flush overloads, and SKMaskFilter.CreateShader, and standardizes the GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo type name. ([#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001))

## Bug Fixes

- **Font handling is more robust** — Managed default-typeface resolution avoids Android startup crashes, variable-font Span methods handle undersized buffers correctly, and SKTypeface.ContainsGlyphs no longer recurses until a StackOverflowException. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730), [#3744](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3744), [#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742))
- **Android SKGLView survives navigation** — Reattaching an SKGLView after a MAUI TabBar switch or page navigation now starts its GL thread with the current dimensions instead of leaving a blank 0-by-0 surface. — ❤️ [@SimonvBez](https://github.com/SimonvBez) ([#3076](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3076))
- **Negative SKStream movement corrected** — The native stream move ABI now uses an explicit 32-bit offset, preventing negative values such as -1 from being zero-extended on 64-bit Unix platforms. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3714](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3714))
- **SKPath finalizer ordering crash fixed** — SKPath no longer flushes a builder after disposal begins, preventing a finalizer-thread crash when SKPathBuilder is collected first. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3796](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3796))
- **NanoServer initialization no longer crashes** — Windows NanoServer builds use an empty font manager when DirectWrite and GDI are unavailable, avoiding an AccessViolation during SKTypeface static initialization. ([#3835](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3835))

## Platform

- **Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen assets** — Native packages add linux-bionic binaries for x64 and arm64 plus tizen-x64 and tizen-arm64 runtime assets. — ❤️ [@4Darmygeometry](https://github.com/4Darmygeometry) ([#3217](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3217), [#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620))
- **Apple target frameworks realigned** — Libraries use the base 26.0 target platform version so consumers are not forced onto Xcode 26.2, while apps use unversioned Apple TFMs. ([#3798](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3798))

## HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.1.6

HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.1.6 adds variable-font and color-palette APIs, the HBColor value type, and native assets for Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen.

## Preview 3 (May 24, 2026)

Raises WebAssembly native assets to a .NET 8 floor, adds HBColor plus XPS, resource-flush and shader mask-filter APIs, and corrects Vulkan type casing. It fixes NanoServer initialization and refreshes libjpeg-turbo, FreeType and zlib. ## Preview 1 (April 28, 2026)

Introduces Skia m147 with the SKPathBuilder migration, HDR and CICP APIs, variable and color fonts, sampling controls, refreshed libpng and libexpat, and new Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen assets.
